items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Teddy Wilson used to come, George Wallington, people like that used to be there. Hank Jones.

ctx.x: Did you ever get to go out and hear him in a jazz environment?

Yes I did. Oh I used to hear him a lot because he opened up a club in Rochester at that time, and the club in Rochester was the going place. It was named Squeezer’s Bar. And my uncle, as it evolved from the local musicians playing there, he eventually got to booking people out of New York City. So in turn I got to hear all the musicians play out of New York City. But the strange thing about it, he would tell the waitresses that worked in the club and the bartenders never to tell anyone that he played. No one ever…
Was he afraid they were going to ask him to sit in or something and he would not feel—
